summary.headline: Comets in Gemini, Cancer, and Leo
summary.text: Astrological omens attributed to comets appearing in Gemini, Cancer, and Leo, including drought, disease, famine, storms, warfare, political unrest, deaths, crop damage, and regional disasters. The predictions distinguish eastern and western appearances and mention Mars, Rome, Iraq, Egypt, Fars, Khuzestan, and Babylon.
